decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposal is considered acceptable because of its position, design and appearance, would relate well to its site and would not be harmful to either the appearance of the location or the living conditions of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  The development is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan, and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The extension hereby approved shall only be used for office accommodation or ancillary storage for the use of the ground floor office space.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 7 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a two-storey first and second floor extension and single storey rear extension to existing post office.
